newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cypress Semiconductor cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cypress Semiconductor cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Wednesday it lowered its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Cypress Semiconductor Corp to $0.80 per share from $1.30 and projected fiscal 1998 earnings at $1.45.
-- Gruntal said the company's fourth-quarter net income of $0.02 was below its estimates, even though Cypress showed a turnaround in profitability during the quarter.
-- Cypress is moving aggressively with new products and improvements in manufacturing costs, Gruntal said.
-- Cypress designs and makes integrated circuits.
-- Its shares were up 5/8 Wednesday at 13-1/2.
